description: Inject the xorq shared essentials (environment, catalog resolution, and the build-add / recover / verify idioms) into context once per session, so every xorq skill can rely on it without restating it. The essentials file is the single source of truth in skills/_shared/essentials.md; printing it to stdout adds it to Claude's context. No matcher, so it also re-injects on resume / clear / compact.
